decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed shopfront and repositioning of door to flat above, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of 34 Kingsley Road, would be compatible with the appearance of the building and the character of the locality, would improve safety and security, and would not harm the living conditions of the adjoining occupiers. The development is therefore in accordance with Unitary Development Plan policies (Adopted December 2003) ENV-B.1.1, S.4.2 and S.4.7. It is considered that where the development is not compliant with policy there are no adverse effects resulting from this.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the premises are used.
Condition : 4 - The access doorway to the ground floor premises shall have a minimum clear width with the door open of 900 mm.
